claims.claim_text: hierarchical clustering yielded a separate cluster of 22 CVID patients with an abnormal phenotype exhibiting features of profound immunosenescence
Clinical complications more frequently found in these patients include lung fibrosis (in 59% of cases)
Clinical complications more frequently found in these patients include bronchiectasis (55%)
Thrombocytopenia was only found in this cluster (36% of cases, manifested as Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP) or Evans syndrome)
annual influenza vaccinations only 30–40% effective in the most at-risk older populations.
Inflammatory markers increased with age, similar to chronic inflammation associated with human immunosenescence.
